notes: The px4_jsbsim backend runs PX4 SITL against the local JSBSim dynamics bridge via sitl_run.sh.
FlightGear was requested as the 3D viewer for this JSBSim run.
A repo-local MAVSDK action adapter commanded arm, takeoff, and land through PX4's onboard MAVLink UDP listener.
The local MAVSDK path on this host connects to PX4's onboard UDP listener on 14580 while the telemetry collector stays on a separate UDP port such as 14540 or 14550.
